metadata.edit_ratio_note: tool_events.jsonl contains no general file-edit tool; source_mutation_preview is read-only preview work.

definitions.build_invocations: Call count for direct_compile_tu, checkdiff_run, and checkdiff_summary. The checkdiff tools compile internally; this is a call-level loop proxy.
definitions.approx_edit_build_diff_loop_count: Equal to build_invocations, as requested. General edit actions are absent from tool_events.jsonl.
definitions.error_nonzero_exit_count: Events whose status is neither ok/success/null or whose numeric exit_code is nonzero, counted once per event.
definitions.event_duration_min: Elapsed time from the earliest to latest valid event created_at timestamp.
definitions.time_to_first_build_min: Elapsed time from the earliest event to the first build_compile event.
